title: Grilled Aubergine and Baby Beef Skewers
description: A deliciously simple Chinese-inspired dish featuring tender baby beef and smoky grilled aubergine, served with a warm and garlicky sauce.
instructions: Thread the baby beef and aubergine onto skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and brown sugar. Brush the marinade onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through, or until the beef is cooked to your liking.
In a small saucepan, heat the argentinian chimichurri sauce over low heat.
Warm the garlic in the saucepan with the chimichurri sauce, stirring constantly.
Serve the grilled skewers with the warm and garlicky sauce spooned over the top.
Sprinkle with warmly seasoned salt to taste.
